statements.impact_statement: os.Root on Windows junctions: the image ships linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 builds only (syft 1.55.0 and grype 0.121.0, built with go1.26.8), which do not contain the Windows code path.

statements.impact_statement: HTTP/2 server connection-level flow control: syft and grype (go1.26.8) run as command-line clients and start no HTTP server. ShieldMon itself, whose 'serve' command is an HTTP server, is built with go1.27.3 and is not covered by this statement.
